(5 items) When you deal damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack, you mark the enemy with unstable energies for |cffffff10|r seconds. If your mark was already active before applying, it instead detonates, dealing |cffffff1071|r Magic Damage all enemies within |cffffff8|r meters. This effect can occur once every |cffffff3|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
